description: Lorlatinib is recommended, within its marketing authorisation, as an option for treating ALK-positive advanced non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in adults whose disease has progressed after alectinib or ceritinib as the first ALK tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI), or after crizotinib and at least one other ALK TKI. It is recommended only if the company provides lorlatinib according to the commercial arrangement.
